summary: Operator page and 2026 rules PDF live. Confirmed fees $45-60, hookups 50/water/sewer (derived -> manual), year-round season (Area II; Area I Apr-Oct), phone booking with the 2-night minimum; sites 207 -> 212 (the page's own area counts); added Wi-Fi, dump station, booking-window and deposit terms. Note cleaned of site/hookup/booking facts and 'Year-round'; minimum-stay line kept.
flags: Gate facts (private nonprofit): cheapest RV night $45 (Area I inland, April-October only); in November-March only Area II is open and its cheapest RV night is $50 ('B-1 only', unclear whether that is an RV class) or $55 inland - over $50 in winter. 2-night minimum (2 x $45 = $90). Not a Good Sam Park; nearest gateway none within 40 km (gateways.py: GSMNP 74 km); no trip references. Presence: own website and phone.

Ordinary nights: yes - 'spaces reserved for the week or for the day are available the first working day of January (current year) by phone'; the rules say 'Not a residential park, seasonal camping only'. Not event-only. Monthly spaces are sold from November of the year before; no count of monthly vs daily sites is published (test 4 passes on no count).

Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'lakeview', but the rate table sells 'RV's LAKESIDE' sites in both areas and the campground loop sits on a peninsula into Lake Chatuge with pads along the shore on imagery. The lakeside sites may be lakefront.
Site count: page says 207 but its own area counts total 212 (93 + 119); recorded 212.
Pin 34.97120,-83.77400 is on the campground peninsula - fine.
